title: Smart Sustainability Bat Box
description: Built a sensor-equipped bat box with on-device computer vision on an Arduino UNO Q that detects bats at ~100 fps, streaming data to a live dashboard with maintenance advice.
longDescription: Built a sensor-equipped bat box with on-device computer vision to detect bats on an Arduino UNO Q at ~100 fps, created at MHacks 2026.
Fine-tuned the BatNet model in PyTorch on 10,000+ daylight photos, cutting false alarms from 42% to 13% at 70% recall.
Streamed sensor data over Wi-Fi to Firebase and built a website that pulls it into a dashboard with maintenance advice.
